A '''plasma-grid''' was a machine designed to [[Drill/Legends|cut through]] rock.<ref name="SOTES" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of the ''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]'' multimedia project, which includes the ''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]'', to [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].</ref> [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] used [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]]-grids to form a smooth construction surface in the rock of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Kile]]'s [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]] foothills in order to build a temporary [[Rebel base (Kile)|prefab base]] for the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]]. The base continued to smell of burned rock from the plasma-grids<ref name="SOTES" /> during Rogue Squadron's<ref name="SOTE">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref> brief<ref name="SOTES" /> [[Time/Legends|time]] there, which included<ref name="SOTE" /> a quick [[Battle of Gall|mission]] to the nearby [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gall/Legends|Gall]].<ref name="SOTES" />

==Behind the scenes==
The plasma-grid was mentioned in the [[1996]] ''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]'', written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="SOTES" />
